instruction: Well, 4 and 5 are unfortunate. I’m ok with the decision on 6. Were the others correct? What error rate did we have for each optional adjudicator?
scope: Accept the observed RQ06 union into both Denton Council and Library Board feeds for this measured case only. No acceptance of RQ04/RQ05, general union policy, production activation or additional calls.
limitation: Conditional small samples with different answered-case sets; not a head-to-head accuracy ranking. JEV measures semantic correctness of its selected proposal, not exact agreement with Gemini.
